profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Desktop/Web Full Stack Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the Defense & Space, Public Safety, Legal, and Insurance industries.

positions.title: Contractor Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked in an Azure DevOps environment utilizing Agile (2-week sprints) providing back-end support for Tricare Management applications
•	Responsible for creating and/or modifying console applications in C# (.NET Framework 4.9 and NET 8.0) that run through special processes to provide data to Humana Military Healthcare application consumers. Deployment via pipelines.
•	Created complex SQL Server queries for stored procedures, user-defined functions and user-defined types
•	Created and modified SSIS packages to allow for data replication and enhanced data integrity

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Using C#/VB.net, developed and maintained new and existing features, also fixed bugs for online printing and mailing service workflow groups and processes 
•	Worked in SQL Server and Oracle databases analyzing data, created and modified database objects and also created numerous customer-specific reconciliation reports
•	Utilized Azure DevOps with User Stories, boards, pipelines for CI/CD, repos for 2-week sprints

positions.title: Systems Consultant III
positions.locationName: Greensboro, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Full Stack web developer in C#/VB.Net supporting internal manufacturing applications.
•	Oracle database as backend, ASP.NET, MVC and Classic ASP supporting making modifications and adding new functionalities.
•	JavaScript and jQuery for client-side development incorporating Bootstrap and DataTables.

positions.title: Consultant/Trainer
positions.description: Taught Microsoft Official Curriculum (MOC) as a MCT in various tech schools located across the U.S.

positions.title: Business Intelligence (BI) Consultant/MOC Trainer
positions.description:
•	Worked as a Business Intelligence (BI) Consultant providing analytical reporting capabilities 
using data warehousing, OLAP, DTS, and Microsoft web controls.
•	Taught Microsoft Official Curriculum (MOC)

positions.title: Systems Analyst/Project Leader
positions.description:
•	Worked as a desktop developer for the U.S. Army Aviation and Missile blueprint repository system.
•	Used Visual Basic window forms and SQL Server.

positions.title: Case Management System Programmer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for maintaining 3rd party high-risk insurance case management system 
which required specific training from the system's creators.
•	Created and maintained user's PCs and local network.

positions.title: COBOL Mainframe Programmer
positions.locationName: Oakbrook Terrace, Illinois, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Worked as a COBOL programmer to develop and maintain job programs that handled daily transactions from the Federal Savings and Loans institutions.
•	Development was conducted in a BORROUGHS/UNYSIS mainframe environment.
